# 10X Shop

> 10X Shop is a demo online store built with React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS as a graduation project. Product data comes from the public DummyJSON API; login, payment and orders are simulated in the browser.

## Pages

- [Catalog](https://10x-shop-gurami.netlify.app/): browse, search, filter and sort products
- [Wishlist](https://10x-shop-gurami.netlify.app/wishlist): products saved by the visitor
- [Compare](https://10x-shop-gurami.netlify.app/compare): side-by-side product comparison
- [Cart](https://10x-shop-gurami.netlify.app/cart): cart, promo code and delivery methods

## Product pages

Each product has its own address built from its name, for example `https://10x-shop-gurami.netlify.app/products/essence-mascara-lash-princess`.

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/GuramAbramishvili/10x-shop-gurami)
